title_original: 해양에서 발생한 재난의 긴급구조활동 평가 및 긴급구조교육에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Composition of Emergency Rescue Activity Evaluation Teams)
(1) After a disaster situation has ended, the head of the Central Rescue Headquarters, a Regional Rescue Headquarters, or a Local Rescue Headquarters under Article 5 of the Act on Search and Rescue, etc. at Sea (hereinafter referred to as the "head of a Rescue Headquarters") shall form an emergency rescue activity evaluation team (hereinafter referred to as an "evaluation team") to evaluate the emergency rescue activities of emergency rescue support agencies.
(2) An evaluation team shall consist of at least five and not more than seven members, including one team leader.
(3) The head of the Rescue Headquarters forming an evaluation team under paragraph (1) shall serve as its leader, and shall appoint or commission members from among the following persons. In such cases, at least two members in total shall be persons falling under subparagraph 2 or 3:
1. Public officials belonging to the Central, Regional, or Local Rescue Headquarters under Article 5 of the Act on Search and Rescue, etc. at Sea who hold a position equivalent to Grade 5 or higher, or who have at least three years of experience in emergency rescue activities;
2. Executives or employees of institutions or organizations that participated in emergency rescue activities;
3. Persons whom the team leader deems necessary, who have expertise in evaluating emergency rescue activities or at least five years of experience in a related field.
